meta.name: full_cruise_maneuver_pid_xcmg_v1
meta.description: XCMG XDE360 (220-ton) - Full cruise: forward at 20 kph, right turn, stop, reverse with counter-steer, stop, forward again with turn

segments.comment: Phase 1: Straight cruise forward - accelerate to 20 kph (5.5 m/s)
Phase 2: Forward right turn at +15 deg, maintain cruise speed
Phase 3: Decelerate to full stop while maintaining right turn - ~7s theoretical, 20s budget
Phase 4: Hold stopped - gear-change guard ensures |v| < 0.2 m/s before Reverse is engaged
Phase 5: Reverse gear (2) + left counter-steer -15 deg at 2.5 m/s (~9 kph). Target is positive magnitude - PID velocity flip handles direction
Phase 6: Decelerate to standstill while still reversing with counter-steer
Phase 7: Hold stop - gear-change guard enforces |v| < 0.2 m/s before Forward is re-engaged
Phase 8: Forward gear again, right turn +15 deg, accelerate back to cruise 20 kph
Phase 9: Straighten steering, cruise forward to end of scenario

gear_safety.note: Runner enforces |v| < 0.2 m/s before allowing gear change. t0 of gear-change segments is a lower bound, not a hard switch.

reverse_pid_convention.note: In reverse gear (gear_position=2), the runner negates currentVelocity before passing to PID. Targets are positive magnitudes. Gear command provides direction to motor controller.
reverse_pid_convention.example: target_velocity_mps=2.5 + gear=2 means: reverse at 2.5 m/s

stop_timing.note: Conservative budget accounts for controller lag and 220-ton inertia
